snippet.title: Official Trailer - Aperture Dating Simulator
snippet.description:
Set in an alternate universe from the series that inspired it, Aperture Dating Simulator will introduce you to a new Aperture Laboratories  - one that seems a lot more... normal than the original. At first.

Take control of a manufacturing employee thrust out of their element and into maintenance, where you'll meet 8 brand-new personality cores, each with their own special little quirks. From level-headed supervisor Miss Esther to hot-tempered sports fanatic Rob, there's plenty of new "faces" to get to know.

Aperture Dating Simulator is fully voiced by a group of independent voice actors and programmed by a single developer. With 18 endings to discover and more than 30 cutscenes to unlock, there's a lot this little dating sim parody has to offer. Or so we hope.

What do you have to lose? Your dignity? If you've watched this video, it's already long gone.
